svg.title: Wiring diagram for the 30-pin ESP32 on the half-size breadboard
svg.desc: The ESP32 sits in columns 16 to 30 with its 3V3 row in row i and USB pointing right. Jumpers: j30 to the plus rail, j29 to the minus rail. The nRF24L01+ radio is drawn chip side up, antenna on the left, with its 2 by 4 pin block on the right. Edge column, top to bottom: MISO, SCK, CE, GND (boxed). Inner column, top to bottom: IRQ, MOSI, CSN, VCC. Radio wires: CE to j26, CSN to j23, SCK to j22, MISO to j21, MOSI to j16, VCC to the plus rail at column 3, GND to the minus rail at column 2, IRQ unconnected. The red and black power wires cross no other wire. A 10 microfarad capacitor sits across the top rails near column 5.
svg.text: label side up, USB to the right
